{{Quote|I have seen the report everyone is debating, and it absolutely does matter where the report originated. Have you seen the isolationist sympathies spreading like red algae bloom across our planet? The alarmists in the popular press would have you think we're on the brink of war!|The Director of the Office of Ethics|<ref name="TOR:MtN" />}}
The '''Director of the Office of Ethics''' was a [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] civil servant who was the head of [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]'s [[Office of Ethics]]. 

==Biography==
{{Quote|This whole thing has gotten way too political. Now it's just a bunch of director-level bureaucrats passive-aggressively arguing with each other. I think one started talking about civil war? Ugh! This report is more trouble than its worth.|[[Go Kila]], to [[Hu Joomi]]|<ref name="TOR:MtN" />}}
During the [[Invasion of Manaan]] they came across a report from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] about untapped [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] reserves. They sent an office-wide message telling everyone to stop talking about the report lest the press get involved, and suggested that the office try to bury the report. They later sent a message to the [[Director of the Office of Extraplanetary Relations]], but the other director ignored their pleas as they sympathized with the Sith.<ref name="TOR:MtN" />
